title: Component Definition
description: Shape of each file in data/components/*.json. Each file describes one placeable component type: its pins and metadata. The filename (without extension) must match the 'type' field.

type.description: Unique machine-readable identifier used in diagram JSON, e.g. 'nodemcu'.

category.description: Broad grouping, mainly for organizing list_component_types output.

description.description: Optional free-text notes about this component or modeling decisions/simplifications.

name.description: Unique (within this component type) pin identifier used in connections, e.g. 'GND', 'D1', 'A+'.

label.description: Optional human-readable pin description, e.g. 'Coil A +'.

group.description: Optional grouping hint for readability, e.g. 'X axis', 'LCD interface'. Not used for layout.
